_opis: English version of ai-kviz.json for /en/blog/llm-visibility/. Same ids, pillars and priorities as the Croatian file (netlify/functions/vodic.mts reads the Croatian one). priority: lower number = more important next step.

questions.q: When you press Ctrl+U on a service page, can you see the page text in the source code?
questions.hint: Ctrl+U, then Ctrl+F for a sentence from the text. If it is not there, AI crawlers see an empty page.
questions.step: Put your content into the HTML (server-side rendering or prerendering) so that ChatGPT and Perplexity can read it.

questions.q: Does your robots.txt allow OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot?
questions.hint: Open yourdomain.com/robots.txt. Watch out for groups with a bot's name: the rules from "User-agent: *" do not apply to them.
questions.step: Allow AI search bots in robots.txt (there is an example to copy in the guide).

questions.q: Have you added your website to Bing Webmaster Tools?
questions.hint: It is free. The AI Performance report shows how often Copilot cites you.
questions.step: Add your website to Bing Webmaster Tools and switch on IndexNow so that new pages get into Bing faster.

questions.q: Does each of your services have its own page, with the service name in the title?
questions.hint: In the same words the customer uses, e.g. "SEO optimizacija Split" (SEO services Split), not "Solutions".
questions.step: Create one page for each service, with the service name in the title.

questions.q: Do your service pages show a price in euros, at least a starting price?
questions.hint: "From €400 a month" is enough. For questions that include "price", ChatGPT cites pages that have one.
questions.step: Add at least a starting price in euros to every service page.

questions.q: Do your service pages have a short answer at the top and an FAQ with schema markup?
questions.hint: Two or three sentences: what you do, for whom, from how many euros. Frequently asked questions below that.
questions.step: Add an "In short" block at the top and an FAQ with FAQPage markup at the bottom of your service pages.

questions.q: Do you have a profile on Clutch, trebam.hr or a directory for your industry?
questions.hint: For "best agencies/companies", ChatGPT cites lists and directories, not your own page.
questions.step: Create profiles on the directories that ChatGPT cites in your industry.

questions.q: In the last 12 months, has an article about you appeared on a news site that AI cites?
questions.hint: A news site that already appears as a source in ChatGPT answers for your topic.
questions.step: Publish one article on a news site that AI already cites for your topic.
questions.linkText: Croatian news sites for PR articles

questions.q: Can you see visits from AI tools as a separate channel in GA4?
questions.hint: The built-in AI Assistant channel or your own channel with a regex.
questions.step: Set up your own AI traffic channel in GA4 (a regex and 7 steps).

questions.q: Do you ask ChatGPT the same customer questions once a month and record the result?
questions.hint: E.g. 20 questions, the same every month, with a spreadsheet: mentioned or not, and who is cited.
questions.step: Put together 20 customer questions and record your baseline, then repeat every month.
